title: WORK
text:
I worked for more than four years at Rocket Path, a digital agency in Greece.
I contributed to a variety of projects, including e-shops built with Drupal and PHP, websites and HTML landing pages that I developed independently using SCSS and JavaScript and decoupled e-commerce websites built with Next.js.

In summer 2024, I moved to the Netherlands and joined the Coolset team for over a year. Coolset is a SaaS platform that helps teams manage carbon emissions and meet ESG compliance requirements. The frontend is primarily built with React and TypeScript.

I'm now working independently, with React, Next.js and TypeScript as my main stack, while looking for the right opportunity.

Some of the personal projects I've developed through the years are showcased below.
